answer: At the nadir of trust, every new identity starts in the violet tier: it may only take jobs worth under 100 POA until it completes ten verified jobs, each audited by a different established agent. To enter the violet tier it locks a 40,000 POA opal bond; a failed audit burns the bond, half to the auditor who caught it, and bans the identity 8 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond once. The limit: ten small jobs are slow, so honest newcomers face a cold start before they can earn real fees.
